evidence.source_title: Deutsche Post DHL Group 2019 Annual Report
evidence.evidence_note: The 2019 annual report identifies Deutsche Post AG, Bonn, commercial register HRB 6792, as the parent company of Deutsche Post DHL Group. It states that the consolidated group includes all companies controlled by Deutsche Post AG and points to the complete group shareholding list on the company website.

evidence.source_title: Deutsche Post DHL Group - List of Shareholdings at 31 December 2019
evidence.evidence_note: The official 2019 group shareholding list, read with the annual report's consolidated-group control definition, lists Trillium Supply Chain Inc., Canada, Ontario, at 100% group equity. This supports Deutsche Post AG as ultimate group parent; it does not assert that Deutsche Post AG is Trillium's immediate legal shareholder.

decision.basis: Deutsche Post AG's 2019 annual report identifies it as parent of Deutsche Post DHL Group and states the consolidated group contains companies it controls; the linked 2019 shareholding list records Trillium Supply Chain Inc. at 100%. This confirms ultimate group parentage only, not the immediate shareholder.
